Open the [export prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=export) and select **Download full backup**. Confirm that the completed file and its listed contents match what you mean by having your whole collection safely back in your hands.

I’ve assumed the full backup includes bookmark details, labels, dates, reading and put-away states, saved page copies, and original PDFs. A separate browser-readable file keeps names, addresses, and label folders portable to other tools without pretending it can carry the richer preserved content.
